raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the “except” qualifier and the geochemical sources of ocean salinity, incorrectly concluding that reactions on the sea floor do not contribute salt while melting glacial ice does. In reality, melting glacial ice contributes fresh water (not salt), whereas volcanic emissions and sea-floor reactions (e.g., hydrothermal inputs) are recognized sources of dissolved ions. The Planner also prematurely declared the task complete without verification using available specialist capabilities, leading to the wrong answer.
